lines: You stare at your phone, hoping a text means forever.
A monk watches a candle melt, wax dripping unnoticed.
He says the flame never asks the wax to stay hard.
The wax is the grip, the flame is the feeling.
When you stop forcing the wax to hold, the fire moves.
Stay in the fire’s glow, not the cold wax shape.
Otherwise you’ll keep burning yourself, you deserve better.
Follow for more daily life changing wisdom.

caption: Love burns brighter when you let go of the shape you expect. Share if this resonates.
